en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. Abi (rah) from Sa’d b. Abdillah from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah from his father from Wahab b. Wahab from Ja’far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (a.s.) who said: “

One who offers a two rakat Nafila Salaat even if it is simple at the time of unawareness it would make him reach the door of Mercy (Paradise).” Someone asked, “O Messenger of Allah! What is this time of unawareness?” He replied, “It is between Maghrib and Isha prayers.”
